howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照一份清单检查代码的正确性、安全性、性能、质量、测试和文档，并特别关注 AI 相关逻辑与幻觉问题。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 审查代码或进行代码评审时触发。

say.text: 请帮我审查这段代码，检查是否有安全漏洞。
say.note: Claude 会按清单逐项检查安全性。

say.text: 评审这个函数，注意性能问题和代码质量。
say.note: Claude 会检查 N+1 查询、循环、命名等。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will check code against a checklist covering correctness, security, performance, quality, testing, and documentation, with special attention to AI logic and hallucinations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to review code or perform a code review.

say_en.text: Please review this code for security vulnerabilities.
Review this function for performance and code quality.
say_en.note: Claude will check N+1 queries, loops, naming, etc.
